source: Iowa DOR 2026 withholding formulas and tables (issued 2025-11-03, accommodating OBBBA; IA W-4 form 44-019c 11/13/2025): flat 3.8%; standard deduction $13,000 single/married-dual-income/other, $19,500 head of household, $26,000 married single-income (encoded as the married_joint jurisdiction); $40/yr tax credit per allowance (after-bracket credit). School-district surtax / EMS surtax not modeled (local, out of scope).
